summary: Full E2E of the new Admin/CMS dashboard passed. Unauthenticated /admin shows Login with google-signin; injected admin session cookie unlocks the Dashboard with all 14 expected sidebar tabs and admin-logout. Hero eyebrow edit persisted: PUT /api/content -> Save shows 'Saved to database', GET /api/content confirmed 'THIS IS 7HUES EDITED', and the public homepage hero-eyebrow reflected the change. Settings tab shows Logo and Motorcycle ImageInputs with preview thumbnails (2 preview imgs rendered). Media Library loads /api/media and shows Upload media control + existing thumbnail. Bookings tab loads /api/bookings and renders 4 rows. Logout returns to login screen. Eyebrow was restored to 'THIS IS 7HUES' after test.

issues: 'Saved to database' status uses gold on charcoal — legible but small; disappears after 2.5s. Consider a toast for accessibility.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_current_user: session lookup fine, but consider indexing db.user_sessions.session_token for O(1) lookups.
server.py PUT /api/content merges via $set on top-level keys only — nested field patches are full replacements. Acceptable for this CMS.
Admin.js MediaLibrary lacks loading/error state around GET /api/media; silently swallows errors (.catch(() => {})). Same for Bookings and content fetch. Consider surfacing errors to the admin.
Admin.js does not memoize sections list ordering (minor).
No confirmation dialog on delete media (Trash2 button) — a single click permanently soft-deletes.
Admin Login button starts OAuth by hard-navigating with window.location.origin + '/admin' — correct per playbook.
